mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.perm_code FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0
SELECT p.id, p.perm_name, p.perm_code, p.uri, p.method FROM sys_role_permission rp INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY p.id ASC
